peoples_entry.name: Izani
peoples_entry.note: The Empire of Iziz (Main Imperial Core & Core Mercenaries — LORE.md §6.2): Roman / Byzantine / Western science-fantasy civilization — bronze & ghost-white Ancient hex loricae, crimson/verdigris pteruges, Imperial sun-orange (#e07a2a) paludamenta, Curule togae praetextae, Solar Flamen / Heliarch / Pontifex vestments, Forgemaster walker pilots, Copper-Sallet Watch (MC-02), and chitin-carapace Land-Crab Auxilia (MC-07) at 100% mpfb_male & mpfb_female parity (tools/garments/cultures/iziz.py).
